description: Answers "is my child competitive", "should we apply" and "are we too late" for one to four schools (TJHSST, a selective high school or a college) from published data only. Takes the child's current grade and school names, and optionally an unweighted GPA, an SAT or ACT score and the current math course. For each school it returns the application window for this child (early, on time, final stretch, this cycle closed, not eligible for this grade, or unknown), a placement against the school's published score band or eligibility minimum when one exists, and up to three next steps with a link to the free EduAvenues guide. Every figure names its source and date. It compares with published groups of past students and never gives a prediction.

gpa.description: Optional GPA. Use the unweighted core GPA for TJ.

mathCourse.description: Optional current math course, e.g. "Algebra 1 in 7th grade"

targets.description: One to four school names, e.g. ["TJ", "Exeter", "UVA"]

name: standing_report
title: Where my child stands
